h: Burna Boy surprises his mother with Flavour performance at her 59th birthday
p: Burna Boy brought in highlife star Flavour to perform at his mother Bose Ogulu's 59th birthday party. Clips show Mama Burna singing and dancing along, with Phyno and Seyi Vibez among the guests.
body: Afrobeats star Burna Boy surprised his mother and manager, Bose Ogulu, with a live performance by highlife singer Flavour at her 59th birthday party on Thursday, 19 November 2026.

Clips from the celebration, shared widely on X and Instagram, showed Ogulu, popularly known as Mama Burna, overjoyed when Flavour took to the stage. She sang along to his songs and danced throughout the performance.
Burna Boy was later seen hugging his mother during the celebration.
Rappers Phyno and Seyi Vibez were among the guests at the party.
The celebration came the same week Burna Boy was reported to feature on an African radio station in the new GTA 6 video game.
more: Phyno and Seyi Vibez were among the guests.
